_doc: Plan 032 Faz 032b — kernel-owned runtime profiles. This file is the AUTHORITY for what an ARIA agent may run as: model tier, effort, Claude tools, write scope, environment passthrough, external-write permission, per-run budget and concurrency. Agent markdown under .claude/agents/ REFERENCES a profile by id (`runtime_profile:`) and MIRRORS model/effort/tools for the Claude Code loader; a mirror that disagrees with this file fails validation, and this file lives under READONLY_PATHS + the authority hash, so an agent cannot widen its own envelope by editing prose it can reach.

planner.description: Read-only planning and drafting on the most capable tier.

planner_orchestrator.description: Read-only lead that may dispatch sub-agents (Agent tool).

judge_opus.description: Read-only evidence/adversarial judgment and review on the opus tier.

judge_glm.description: Read-only judgment on the cross-provider glm tier (vendor diversity for the judge pair).

arbiter.description: Read-only consensus arbitration; sees judge outputs only.

implementer.description: Write-capable implementer. Workspace-wide write scope minus READONLY_PATHS; the ONLY profile with external_writes — a scoped, per-spawn GH token (delivery_credentials) for `git push origin aria-impl-*` and the kernel's own `pr create`; every other external write stays denied by CommandPolicy + hooks (Faz 032d).

worker.description: Write-capable worker / gap fixer in an assigned worktree; same envelope as the implementer.

validator.description: Read-only validator that may run test/lint commands (Bash) but never edits.
